summary: Oklo Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an equity distribution agreement with ten sales agents for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $1 billion in Class A common stock. Sales may be made in ordinary brokers' transactions, block trades, or negotiated transactions at prevailing market prices. Commission is up to 1.5% of gross sales price per share. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or structural change is involved.
